notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Q-series sheet W5-Q12 'High wind area' warning sign (2023; used with the W8-Q14 plate per note 2 and the example). Size A 600 diamond generated (B 750, C 900 also tabled): a 600 side drawn as the bounding square 848.53, r 40, b 10 yellow edge + c 20 black border (separate spans on the sheet). Symbol box from the table: e 190 left and f 286 right of the vertical centreline (476 wide), d 170 above and below the horizontal centreline (340 tall): x 234.27, y 254.27. The symbol is the sheet PDF's own vector path (tools/symbols/qld_w5-q12_windsock.svg, vec2sym2, not traced), drawn 490.8 x 350.5 on the sheet's sign (3 % larger than the tabled box, as the other Q-series symbols), scaled into the box. Black on retroreflective yellow.
